meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成支持备注和跳转的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常要把资料整理成可演示的幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn your content into a presentation deck with speaker notes and branching.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn rough notes into a navigable slide deck for presenting.

howto.what: 把用户资料或页面做成幻灯片 deck——独立页、演讲备注、分步显现、分支跳转、热点导航，并带演讲者模式；产出是可运行的网页 deck，不是视频。
howto.when: 明确要求做幻灯片，或要求把现有页面转成幻灯片时启动；只泛称“演示”“deck”时，会先确认是否按 HyperFrames slideshow 做，再开工。

say.text: 把提案里的三个要点做成五页 slideshow，并加演讲备注。
say.note: Claude 会按顺序排好各页主干并写入演讲备注。

say.text: 把这篇文章页面转成一套 HyperFrames slideshow。
say.note: 已明确是 slideshow，会直接开始转换页面。

say.text: 做一套演示 deck，点击热点可跳到分支页，内容分步出现。
say.note: 这会用到分支、热点和片段逐步显现。

howto.what_en: Creates a HyperFrames slideshow deck from user material or an existing page — slides, speaker notes, fragment reveals, branches, hotspots, presenter mode. Output is a runnable navigable deck, not a video.
howto.when_en: Starts for explicit slideshow/slide-show requests or page-to-deck conversion. For vague asks like “presentation”/“deck”, it confirms HyperFrames slideshow before authoring.

say_en.text: Turn the three points in this proposal into a 5-slide deck with notes.
say_en.note: It arranges each slide and speaker notes in sequence.

say_en.text: Turn this article URL into a HyperFrames slideshow.
say_en.note: It starts converting directly since slideshow is explicit.

say_en.text: Make a deck with clickable hotspots that branch and reveal fragments.
say_en.note: Uses branches, hotspots, and step reveals.
